_note: Written by npm run precompute; do not edit. Positions in decimetres from the kit centre. rings: teleport stations (kind stop: above a transport building, the kit has no bus stops; service: above a large service building; merged: stations closer than rings.merge_within_m joined at their midpoint, buildings and kinds list them), node: the walkable node they start from. stops: where the Today bus stands, next to each stop (angle: street direction, radians). zones: pressure zones per walking time, as bands (the 10-minute band without the 5-minute zone, …), polygons of rings (outer first, then holes). main_edges: indices of streets.graph.json walkable edges (in file order) that carry the main paths; gathering: gathering places. interactions: where species routes cross a road or path at a height within people.path_height_band_m, points closer than interactions.merge_within_m merged; members: [route id in routes.json, line point k]; shown in a layout where one of its routes is drawn past its point k.
